title: Junta match indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a finite subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $z$ assign a sign to each index in $P$, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. The match observation is $1$ if $x$ agrees with $z$ on every index in $P$, and is $0$ otherwise.
